PREFERRED:

You must have experience analysing and structuring residential and investment lending.

ApplyOnline (AOL)

Quickli

Preparing high quality credit submissions



Assisting with complex lending scenarios including SMSF and trust structures

Many offshore roles in mortgage broking are administrative.



This role is not.



You will be working with brokers who specialise in complex and high-value lending, including medical professional lending, SMSF lending, trust lending, commercial lending, and high-net-worth borrowers.

Available full-time during GMT+8 hours

Packaging, bottles, glass, or spirits/beverage experience

QC, inspection, or freight/logistics background

title: E-Learning Module Production Specialist
description:
About the Project

We are producing 8 self-paced virtual learning modules (plus one short orientation module)

for a professional development project in K-12 education. Each module is a 10-20 minute

narrated, interactive learning experience delivered as a SCORM package via LMS.

The full series is produced in both English and Spanish (18 modules total: 9 English + 9

Spanish). The English modules will be produced first. Upon successful completion, the same

workflow will be repeated for the Spanish versions using translated scripts and slide decks that

we provide.



All content, narration scripts, slide decks (.pptx), and companion documents are already

created. We need a production specialist to take finished assets through the final audio and

publishing pipeline.



Scope of Work

You will be responsible for four production phases per module:

Phase 1: AI Voice Generation (ElevenLabs)

• Generate narrated audio from finalized, slide-by-slide narration scripts using ElevenLabs

text-to-speech

• Each module contains 15-20 slides, each with its own narration block (total ~1,500-2,800

words per module)

• Match voice settings (stability, clarity, style) to a reference sample we will provide for

Module 1 in each language

• Export individual audio files per slide (labeled by slide number)

• QC each clip for mispronunciations, pacing issues, and unnatural breaks, especially on

education-specific terminology (IEP, ESSA, IDEA, WIDA, and state-specific acronyms)

• For Spanish modules: QC audio for artifacts, pacing, and unnatural breaks (translated

scripts and linguistic review are handled separately)

• Re-generate and splice as needed until each clip meets quality standards

• A pronunciation guide is provided with every narration script

Phase 2: iSpring Suite Assembly

• Import the completed .pptx slide deck into iSpring Suite Max (desktop application,

Windows required)

• Sync generated audio to each slide with correct timing

• Configure slide transitions and advance settings (audio-driven, not click-to-advance)

• Preview and test full module playback end-to-end



Phase 3: Accessibility QA

• Verify reading order in PowerPoint (Selection Pane) matches logical content flow on

every slide

• Write or refine alt text for all images, graphics, and diagrams based on provided

descriptions

• Verify caption transcript files align with final audio (timing, content match)

• Run color contrast checks on all text and background combinations (minimum 4.5:1 for

normal text, 3:1 for large text per WCAG 2.1 AA)

• Confirm all non-text information conveyed by color also has a non-color indicator (labels,

patterns, icons)

• Test keyboard/tab navigation in the published module to ensure all content is reachable

without a mouse

• Log all findings in an accessibility checklist per module

Phase 4: SCORM Packaging and QA

• Publish each module as a SCORM 1.2 package (or SCORM 2004 if specified)

• Configure completion tracking rules (e.g., viewed all slides)

• Configure resume behavior (learner can exit and return where they left off)

• Test the published SCORM package in SCORM Cloud or equivalent LMS test

environment

• Verify: audio plays correctly on all slides, completion triggers properly, package resumes

on re-entry

• Deliver the final .zip SCORM package and a brief QA checklist per module

Deliverables Per Module

1. Audio files (one per slide, .mp3, labeled)

2. Published SCORM .zip package (tested and verified)

3. Accessibility checklist per module (reading order, alt text, contrast, keyboard nav)

4. Brief QA log noting any issues found and resolved during testing

What We Provide

• Finalized PowerPoint slide deck (.pptx) for each module

• Finalized narration script with slide-by-slide text, word counts, and pronunciation guide

• Storyboard with slide-by-slide specs

• ElevenLabs voice profile and settings (configured after Module 1 approval)

• iSpring Suite Max license (or you may use your own)

• Access to a test LMS environment for SCORM verification



Requirements

Must have:



• Hands-on experience with iSpring Suite (not just iSpring Free or iSpring Converter)

• Experience publishing SCORM packages and testing in an LMS

• Familiarity with ElevenLabs or equivalent AI voice tools

• Windows computer (iSpring Suite is Windows-only)

• Strong attention to detail, especially audio-to-slide sync

• Comfortable working independently from written specs

Nice to have:

• Background in education, training, or instructional design

• Experience with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility in e-learning (alt text, reading order,

captions, contrast)

• Familiarity with SCORM Cloud for testing

• Experience producing modules for government or K-12 clients

Timeline and Volume

Detail Value

Total modules 18 (9 English + 9 Spanish)

Pricing and turnaround Fixed rate per module (3 business day

turnaround)

Test module Module 1 (English) is a paid test before full

commitment

English completion August 2026

Spanish completion September 2026

Modules will be delivered in batches as content is finalized, not all at once.

Strong performers will be considered for ongoing work on future continuing professional

development (CPD) course production.



How to Apply

Please include in your response:

1. Your experience with iSpring Suite (which version, how many modules produced)

2. Your experience with ElevenLabs or AI voice generation

3. A sample or description of a SCORM package you have produced

4. Your fixed rate per module and estimated turnaround time per module

5. Your availability through September 2026

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
We are looking for a sharp, reliable, and proactive Virtual Assistant to support two parallel workstreams: 75% of your time will be dedicated to Rebel Leader Lab business operations, and 25% will be personal executive assistant support for the Founder and CEO.



THIS IS NOT A TASK-TICKER ROLE.

We are not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to happen, figures out how to make it happen, and brings it to completion without being chased. If you need a detailed checklist for every action, this is not the right fit. If you are someone who spots a gap, solves it, and reports back with a completed task — keep reading.



THE 75 / 25 SPLIT



75% — Rebel Leader Lab Business Operations

This is the majority of your role. You are the operational backbone of a growing consultancy. You support the CEO, COO, and Director of Programs in keeping client delivery, content, and business development running smoothly.



What You Own



Client Operations

Prepare Sprint pre-materials and send to clients 48 hours before Sprint day. Manage secure portal links for AI Anxiety Index™ and RRQ™ observer nominations. Track observer response rates and follow up when below 60%. Maintain client contact database in HubSpot. Send REBEL Readiness Report™ to clients within 48-hour window after Sprint.



Calendar + Scheduling

Own the CEO’s calendar for all client-facing meetings. Schedule qualification calls, retainer sessions, quarterly reviews, and speaking engagements. Send meeting prep documents 24 hours in advance of every call. Manage Calendly links and ensure they are always current.



Content Support

Research podcast guest candidates and prepare briefing documents. Draft LinkedIn post outlines from CEO’s voice notes and raw ideas for CEO review. Build the monthly content calendar in Notion or Airtable. Pull engagement analytics weekly from LinkedIn and the podcast host.



Business Development Support

Maintain the HubSpot CRM — log every contact, every call, every proposal stage. Research CHRO and CPO prospects monthly (50 qualified contacts per month). Track conference and speaking opportunity calendar. Prepare first-draft proposal documents from templates for ER Lead review.




 Workspace

Keep all project boards current. Create task cards when action items are identified in meetings. Chase overdue tasks before they become problems. Prepare the weekly operations digest for the COO every Monday morning.



Vendor + Contractor Management

Track invoices and payment schedules for all contractors and service providers. Follow up on outstanding deliverables. Maintain the vendor contact list and contract renewal calendar.



Research

Research grant opportunities and track application deadlines (working alongside the grant intern). Research conference speaking opportunities 6 months in advance. Research prospective university partnership contacts. Compile competitive intelligence on other leadership and AI consultancy offerings quarterly.



Document Management

Maintain the master document library in Google Drive. Ensure all tools, templates, and client documents are in the correct folders and named correctly. Prepare document packages for client delivery. Send fully completed documents to clients with correct branding.





25% — Personal Executive Assistant to the Founder



The CEO is building a company and a personal brand simultaneously. The personal support role keeps her personal life running smoothly so her full capacity goes into the business.



What You Own



Personal Calendar

Manage personal appointments, personal travel, family commitments, and personal deadlines. Ensure business and personal calendars are always deconflicted. Buffer travel time appropriately.



Travel Coordination

Research and book all personal and business travel: flights, hotels, ground transportation. Prepare complete travel itineraries with all confirmation numbers, addresses, and contact information. Manage loyalty program accounts and ensure points are always applied.



Inbox Management

Monitor and triage the CEO’s personal and professional
 inboxes. Flag urgent items. Draft responses for CEO approval. Unsubscribe from low-value lists. Maintain a daily inbox digest summary.



Personal Errands + Research

Research personal purchases, contractors, services, and vendors. Coordinate personal appointments (medical, wellness, personal care). Research gift options for clients, partners, and personal relationships. Track personal subscription renewals and flag before auto-charges.



Expense Tracking

Log all personal and business expenses in the tracking system. Reconcile receipts weekly. Flag anything that needs a receipt and chase it before month-end. Prepare expense summary for the finance intern monthly.



Home + Life Admin

Manage home service providers (maintenance, cleaning, deliveries). Track home warranties, insurance renewals, and annual maintenance schedules. Handle shipping, returns, and online order tracking.

title: AI Engineer & Operations (m/f/d)
description:
mala markets is a specialized marketplace agency managing Amazon, OTTO, Kaufland, and eBay for European brands. We are rebuilding how agency work gets done: through agentic AI systems, internal automation, and our own marketplace software – all built in-house by the team.



This role sits at the intersection of engineering and strategy. You write production code and you think at the level of the business. You ship systems that the team depends on daily, and you help define what those systems should be. Neither half is optional.



What You'll Build

The engineering side of this role is concrete and consequential. You own what you ship.

– Design, build, and deploy AI automation systems using Claude Code and agentic frameworks – production quality, not prototypes

– Build agentic pipelines that take over real, recurring tasks from the team

– Architect and integrate MCP servers across our tool and data ecosystem

– Own features in our marketplace software: from architecture decisions to live deployment

– Write clean, maintainable Python and/or JavaScript code that others can build on

– Integrate APIs, handle edge cases, debug across the stack – end-to-end ownership



What You'll Solve

The operational side of this role requires structured thinking at a high level. You identify what is broken before it becomes a crisis.



– Analyze complex process and workflow problems – in our team and in client operations – and develop solutions that actually get implemented

– Evaluate AI tools and emerging capabilities, translate them into concrete decisions and recommendations for leadership

– Build decision frameworks, prioritization logic, and documentation that drive action – not documents that gather dust

– Define what gets engineered next: you set the brief, validate the approach, and stay accountable for the outcome

– Bridge the gap between business need and technical execution across every team function



What We Need



Non-negotiable

– Production-level programming in Python and/or JavaScript – you write code that runs in the real world, not just in notebooks

– Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks: Claude Code is preferred; LangChain, AutoGen, or comparable accepted

– Understanding of software architecture, API design, versioning, and deployment workflows

– Ability to take a problem from blank page to shipped solution, independently

– Structured analytical thinking – you decompose ambiguous problems methodically and communicate the reasoning clearly

– Direct, precise communication: you can brief leadership and brief an engineer in the same hour



Strong advantage

– Experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) beyond wrapper scripts

– Familiarity with MCP server architecture and tool ecosystems

– Knowledge of marketplace operations (Amazon Seller Central, OTTO, Kaufland, eBay)

– German language skills – valuable for client-facing work

– Exposure to no-code/low-code automation (Make, n8n, Zapier) as a complement to engineering



Why mala markets

We are a boutique agency with a sharp focus: marketplace growth for ambitious brands across Europe. Small team, high standards, and a genuine belief that AI changes what good agency work looks like.



– You work directly with leadership – no layers, no politics

– What you build gets used. Immediately. By the whole team

– We build our own software products alongside client work – real product responsibility

– Remote-first with the option to work from our Dortmund office

– Competitive salary commensurate with the level of the role proud of.

title: Project Manager for a Marine Film Production Company (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Rising Tide Film makes story-driven films and photos for boating and fishing brands. Think cinematic brand documentaries, not corporate videos. Our clients are boat builders and marine brands in the US and Australia. Our work lives and dies on the details, and on living and breathing the world of boating and fishing.



We're a small remote team: a founder who shoots and directs, a video editor, and a social media manager.



About This Role

I'm Steve, the founder. I'm on boats, on shoots, and on the road a lot. I love that. But right now everything runs through me. When I'm three days into a shoot, my team is waiting on feedback and my clients are waiting on approvals only I can give.



I'm hiring you to keep everything moving when I can't. Not an assistant who waits for tasks. A project manager who owns the whole process.



What You'll Own

Project communication. 

You're the hub between me, the team, and our clients. Feedback gets routed, tracked, and done. When I'm unreachable, projects don't stall..



First-pass review. 

Nothing reaches me until you've checked it against our playbook. Wrong boat name, missed revision note, you catch it before I do. My goal: I review 1 in 10 things, not 10 in 10.



The standard, in my voice. 

Rising Tide is a personal brand. Everything we put out has to sound like me and hit a bar the industry notices. You'll learn my voice well enough to say "this isn't us yet" before I would. Nothing ships at "good enough."



The weekly meeting. 

Every project, status, blockers, deadlines. Your meeting, not mine.



The podcast. 

The Rising Tidecast from recording to published, on a schedule you own.



The money.

Budgeted vs. actual hours so we stay profitable. Invoice follow-ups so I'm not chasing payments on the water. Expenses tracked



Keeping me accountable. 

Daily priorities, follow-ups I've promised, deadlines I've forgotten, briefs before shoots, travel sorted.



Who You Are

You don't need to know boats on day one. You need to be the person who researches what they don't know, documents it so they never ask twice, and triple-checks names before anything ships. In six months you'll know our clients' boats better than most people in the industry, because you built that knowledge on purpose.

You're detail-obsessed in life, not just at work. 

You've worked closely with a founder or personal brand and can absorb how someone thinks and reproduce it. 

You take ownership without being asked. 

You tell me straight when something isn't ready, or when I'm the bottleneck. 

You give feedback that's kind but holds the line. 

You stay calm when plans change, because in production they always do. 

You use AI daily as a multiplier, not a crutch.



Requirements

3+ years as a PM, ops manager, or senior EA for a US or AU company (production or creative a big plus)

C2-level English, written and spoken

Full-time, 40 hours/week

Schedule: 4:00 AM to 12:00 PM US Eastern (4:00 PM to 12:00 AM Philippine Time). You need to catch the end of my team's day and my mornings. Non-negotiable, so make sure it fits your life.

Comfortable running meetings on video

AP/AR or light bookkeeping a plus

Tools

Google Workspace, Zoom, Frame.io, DaVinci Resolve (navigating projects, not editing), Claude, ClickUp.



Pay

$1,200 to $1,600 USD/month depending on experience.

13th month pay. 

Performance bonuses tied to clear KPIs. 

This is a long-term role, and I invest in my team for the long haul.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short intro video (3 minutes max) telling me:

Why you're right for this specific role

How you keep a team on track when the founder is unreachable

The project you're most proud of managing, why, and what made it work



Optional: any personal connection to boats, fishing, or the water? Family, hometown, hobby, anything. I'd love to hear it.



Tight Lines must be in your subject line so I know you read to the end. No keyword, I don't open your application.



What Happens Next

Standout applications get a short paid test task, then a video interview, then a paid one-month trial so we both know it's right before committing.

I'm not looking for someone to take tasks off a list. I'm looking for the person who runs the operation so I can be on the water making the work that pays all of us. If that's you, let's talk.

title: Video Producer / Visual Content Creator for Online Rock Music Project
description:

title: Short Form Video Editor for Instagram Reels (Talking Head Content)
description:
Short Form Video Editor for Instagram Reels (Talking Head Content)



About the role



I run a personal brand in the AI and digital products space. The content is short talking-head Reels for Instagram, filmed at home on a phone. I post daily and need an editor who can turn raw clips into tight Reels that hold attention from the first second.



The style is plain and direct. No heavy effects. The words do the work, not the production.



What you will do



- Cut footage tight. Remove pauses, ums and dead air so the pace stays quick.

- Add burned-in captions. Bold, clean, easy to read on mute, synced to what I say.

- Build a title card and hook at the top of each Reel.

- Add light b-roll, zoom-ins and screen recordings where they help hold attention.

- Add subtle sound design or music when it fits the moment.

- Export at 1080x1920, ready to post.

- Keep a consistent look across every video so the account feels like one brand.



Each Reel is 20 to 60 seconds. One idea per video.



What I am looking for



- Real experience editing short-form vertical video. Reels, TikTok or Shorts. Talking-head work preferred.

- A strong grasp of retention editing. You know the first two seconds decide whether a video works.

- Accurate captions and good written English, so the subtitles match what I say.

- Fast, reliable turnaround. I batch film, so you will get several videos at once.

- Clear communication. You hit deadlines and flag problems early.



Nice to have



- You watch this kind of content yourself and know what good looks like.

- Confident in CapCut, Premiere Pro or After Effects.

- Some interest in AI or online business, so the topics make sense to you.



The setup



This is ongoing work, not a one-off. Expect regular batches every week. Start part-time, with room to grow as the account grows. Hours, volume and rate are in the listing details.



How to apply



1. Start your message with the word REELS so I know you read this post.

2. Send 2 to 3 examples of short vertical videos you have edited. Put talking-head examples first if you have them.

3. Tell me which software you use, and how fast you can turn around one 30 to 60 second Reel.



I read every application that follows these three steps. The rest get skipped.

title: Virtual Sales and Customer Service Associate

• Reliable Internet Access

• High English proficiency 

• Ability to work during U.S. business hours, including evenings and weekends as needed

• Consistent attendance and availability during scheduled shifts are required

________________________________________

Who We Are Looking For



A successful VSCSA is energetic, reliable, and process oriented! We are looking for motivated tea
mbers who want to help provide superior customer service to dog parents, drive appointment bookings, membership conversions, customer retention, and customer satisfaction while achieving individual and team performance goals. A passion for dogs and dog health & wellness is strongly preferred.

• Communicate effectively through phone, text,
, and CRM tools while collaborating with center staff

• Support membership growth through appointment bookings, trial/membership conversions, retention efforts, and reactivation campaigns

• Maintain accurate customer records and document all customer interactions within the CRM and scheduling systems

• Meet or exceed established daily, weekly, and monthly goals for outbound contacts, appointments booked, membership conversions, retention activities, and customer satisfaction

• Represent the Scenthound brand and communicate our mission of dog wellness and preventive care during every customer interaction

________________________________________

Performance Expectations



• Approximately 250–350 outbound contacts per day 

• 8–15 appointments booked per day 

• Achievement of appointment show-rate goals 

• Achievement of membership conversion goals 

• Achievement of membership retention goals 

• Maintain high customer satisfaction scores

________________________________________

Skills and Abilities



• Confidence in selling services and products

• Ability to connect with customers, over the phone, and provide outstanding customer service

• Ability to learn our products and services to educate the dog parents; speak to our values and culture as a basis for our services

• Effective communication with tea
mbers and dog parents (on the phone)

• Attention to detail

• Time-management; Scheduling appointments efficiently

• Accountability

• Persistence and resilience

• Strong verbal communication and active listening

• Relationship building

• Follow-up discipline

• Ability to work independently

• Goal-oriented mindset

• Sales closing techniques

________________________________________

Preferred Qualifications



• Previous call center experience 

• Membership sales experience 

• Veterinary, pet care, grooming, or wellness industry experience 

• Experience using CRM software 

• Experience working remotely 

• Experience meeting or exceeding sales quotas, appointment booking goals, or customer retention targets

________________________________________

Remote Work Requirements



• Reliable high-speed internet access 

• Dedicated quiet workspace free from distractions 

• Computer capable of running CRM, VoIP, and communication software 

• Additional monitor (24" or larger preferred)

• Webcam and headset for meetings and training

________________________________________

Benefits



• Paid training and ongoing professional development

• Remote work environment with scheduling flexibility based on business needs and performance

• Opportunity for advancement into Team Lead and other leadership roles within the virtual sales and customer service team

________________________________________

Compensation



• Competitive hourly pay 

• Performance-based bonus opportunities are tied to appointment bookings, membership conversions, retention, and customer satisfaction metrics

title: Property Accountant
description:
BASIC PURPOSE



Under the direction and supervision of the Accounting Manager, the Property Accountant/Senior Property Accountant will be responsible for the preparation of monthly financial statements for various properties. Specific responsibilities include financial statement preparation and analysis, bank reconciliation preparation/review, journal entry approval, audit participation, research, and accounts payable review.



ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS



· Responsible for monthly financial statement preparation for assigned properties. This task includes interpreting and analyzing property accounting reports on a routine basis.



· Ensure compliance with all relevant accounting standards, regulations, and company policies.



· Responsible for analyzing and creating detailed reconciliation reports including but not limited to prepaid other, capex, property taxes and insurance.



· Prepare monthly bank reconciliations, journal entries, management fee and distribution calculations.



· Assist in budgeting and forecasting on all properties.



· Responsible for initiating/recording wire/ach’s and monitoring the cash position of assigned properties.



· Review accounts payable for accuracy, proper coding and operations approval.



· Collaborate with the operations team to address accounting-related issues and provide financial guidance.



· Prepare audit and tax work papers for quarterly/annual audits/tax returns.



· Assist with special projects as needed.





KNOWLEDGE/EXPERIENCE



BA/BS degree in Accounting or Finance required along with a minimum of three years of Real Estate accounting experience. CPA/MBA preferred. Excellent analytical, communication, and organizational skills are essential. Knowledge of GAAP and real estate accounting principles required. Ability to manage priorities and workflow with versatility, flexibility, and willingness to work within a constantly changing work environment. Entrata/Yardi experience preferred

We are looking for an exceptional communicator to join our team in a role that sits at the intersection of lead qualification, sales support, relationship management, and executive assistance. You will act as the first point of contact for many consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands entering our ecosystem. 



Your primary focus will be to confidently engage with CPG founders, run structured qualification calls, gather and organize business data, and move high-potential prospects through our advisory and partnership funnel. This is not a hard-sales position; the focus is entirely on strategic relationship building, structural organization, qualification, and thoughtful follow-through to identify which businesses are the right fit for our advisory services, retail readiness support, offshore hiring, or broker introductions. 



Timezone: EST

Working Hours: 20 hours per week

Rate: 7 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities

1. Qualification & Discovery Calls

• Run structured 15–20 minute qualification and discovery calls with brand founders and operators. 

• Gather critical business data, including product category/differentiation, current sales channels, retail traction, pricing/margins, retail readiness, operational challenges, and growth goals. 

• Take highly organized, comprehensive notes during calls and synthesize findings internally for leadership review. 

• Identify strong-fit opportunities and accurately route them to the appropriate solutions. 

2. CRM & Pipeline Management

• Maintain pristine CRM records and tracking systems to keep internal databases clean and up to date. 

• Track lead stages, follow-up timelines, and critical next steps across the sales pipeline. 

• Build and maintain standardized call notes, reporting frameworks, and performance systems. 

3. Sales & Advisory Support

• Support founders through the advisory funnel, service options presentation, and onboarding processes. 

• Coordinate clear and professional follow-up communications after strategic calls. 

• Assist with proposal preparation, contract scheduling, and subsequent follow-up tasks. 

• Route qualified brands toward brokers, marketing partners, operators, or strategic partners when relevant. 

4. Executive Assistance & Operations

• Support executive calendar coordination and meeting management workflows. 

• Prepare daily or weekly meeting briefs and executive summaries for leadership review. 

• Organize internal SOPs, scripts, messaging templates, and outreach materials. 

• Proactively improve operational workflows, automation processes, and internal system scaling over time. 



Required Skills & Experience

• Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills with a comfortable phone presence when speaking to founders and senior operators. 

• Experience: Background in sales support, SDR/BDR, executive assistance, customer success, recruitment coordination, or operations support.

- Basic video editing skills. Nothing complicated, just simple, clean edits: cuts, zoom-ins, and similar. You should be comfortable with an editing tool like CapCut, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.

- Able to record your screen and explain the steps in clear, easy-to-follow English.

- You use your own real voice. No AI or text-to-speech voiceovers.

- A good microphone with clear audio.

- Comfortable taking a video from idea to finished result on your own.

- Good communication and open to feedback.



A PLUS

- You actively use tools like ChatGPT, Cursor, or Claude in your own projects.



PAY

- $5 to $6 per finished video to start, with the rate rising as we work together.

- Bonuses for strong, consistent work.

- Steady, ongoing work for the right person.

etups with our Manila-based content and customer support teams.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC Manager to manage and scale advertising campaigns across our Amazon brands. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of improving sales, lowering ACOS/TACOS, and driving profitable growth through data-driven advertising strategies.



Responsibilities

Manage and optimize Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP campaigns.

Conduct keyword research, bid optimization, and search term harvesting.

Monitor and improve ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rates.

Develop launch and ranking strategies for new products.

Analyze competitor advertising strategies and identify growth opportunities.

Create weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.

Collaborate with listing, creative, and catalog teams to improve overall account performance.

Manage advertising budgets and ensure efficient spend allocation.

Requirements

Minimum 3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC management experience.

Proven success managing multiple Amazon accounts and product categories.

Strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Advertising Console.

Experience with tools such as Helium 10, Data Dive, Pacvue, Perpetua, Quartile, or Scale Insights.

Strong analytical and reporting skills.

Excellent communication and project management abilities.

To be considered, applicants must submit a portfolio/case study demonstrating previous Amazon PPC work, including:



Brands or categories managed

Monthly ad spend managed

ACOS/TACOS improvements achieved

Revenue growth results

Product launch success stories

Screenshots of campaign performance (sensitive information may be redacted)

Examples of PPC strategies implemented

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing supplement, health & wellness, or CPG brands.

Experience with Amazon DSP.

Experience launching new products and scaling established brands.

Knowledge of Amazon SEO and listing optimization.

title: AI Image Specialist
description:
Urgent Hiring: AI IMAGE SPECIALIST

Reports To: Creative Asset Manager

Work Hours: 40 hours weekly - Flexible Time



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



This is an AI-first role. 



We are not looking for a traditional graphic designer who occasionally uses AI. We are looking for someone who actively uses AI image generation and editing tools as a core part of their creative process and is passionate about staying ahead of emerging AI technologies. 



Candidates should be prepared to share examples of AI-generated work, discuss their preferred AI tools and workflows, and demonstrate how they use AI to increase creative output and efficiency. 



Company Vision: 

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field.  We value problem solvers, go getters, and people with opinions who want to make an impact.  You will be on the leading edge of graphic design and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.   



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides.  Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products.  We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us! 



That’s where you come in as our AI Image Specialist. 



Role Purpose 

This role is responsible for designing creative and compelling visuals for new and existing products, including illustrations, packaging, and listing images primarily through AI-powered workflows. You will also create diverse marketing materials such as social media graphics and website elements, as needed. 



THIS IS AN AI-FIRST ROLE. 



Primary Objectives 

Lead AI-powered image creation and continuously improve visual production through emerging AI tools and workflows.

Collaborate with the graphics manager & design tea
mbers to align designs with objectives.

Optimize product images to meet e-commerce guidelines and boost performance.

Deliver realistic, high-quality, on-brand ai generated imagery,designs and videos for listings and marketing materials. 



Regular Work Activities 

Research, test, and implement new AI image generation and editing tools. 

Develop effective product visuals, including listing graphics, packaging & instructions aligned with brand identity and target audience using AI workflows. 

Collaborate with the graphic design team. 

Edit and enhance product photography through AI generation. 

Perform necessary edits to create polished and post-ready graphics. 



Key Skills 

Intermediate to Expert-level proficiency with AI image generation platforms. 

Expertise in graphic design, illustration, and photo editing 

Always updating AI knowledge to best use new software and processes. 

Proficient in design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, etc.) 

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams 

Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines 

Knowledge of current design trends and techniques 

Self-starter who raises issues and proposes solutions before asked – a critical thinker who finds mistakes and corrects them 



Role Requirements

title: 2D Animator
description:
About the role:



BattlePaws is looking for a long-term, full-time 2D animator for YouTube content focused on history, mythology, battles, and immersive storytelling videos.



The channel style is inspired by:



- DumbDoggoAnimation — 

 -TheOdd1sOut — 

 -HeyHistorically — 

 -Fast-paced YouTube storytelling animation



The goal is NOT Disney-level animation quality. Strong pacing, comedic timing, visual storytelling, and retention-focused animation matter more than ultra-smooth frame-by-frame work.



Production expectations: 



 Average video length: 10–15 minutes

 Expected workload: 3 videos per month

 Future goal: 30-minute videos as the channel grows

 Minimum export quality: 1080p

 Animation software: any (After Effects, Animate, Toon Boom, Blender, etc.)



Workflow & communication



 Trello is used for project management and production tracking.

 A WhatsApp group is used for daily communication and feedback.

 English does not need to be perfect — but you must be able to clearly understand simple instructions and scripts.



What BattlePaws provides for each video: 



 Full script

 Voice-over (recorded)

 Storyboard images

All final animations and assets created for the channel belong to BattlePaws



Recruitment & filtering process: 



Step 1 — Initial Application Filter



Applicants are first filtered based on:



 Portfolio quality

 Communication

 Responsiveness

 Compatibility with the channel style

This first pass is mainly used to remove low-effort or incompatible applicants and is not heavily scored.



Required in your application (in this order):



1. Start with the word: Legion

2. Brief intro — your name, country, and years of 2D animation experience

3. Confirm you can work FULL-TIME (30–40 hrs/week, ~3 videos/month minimum)

4. Portfolio link (past animation work — at least 2–3 samples)

5. Animation software you use most

6. Your time zone (so we know if we can sync via WhatsApp)

Applications that don't include all six items above, or that don't start with "Legion," will be ignored.



Step 2 — Paid Animation Test

Selected applicants from Step 1 will be invited to a paid animation test.

The test materials are hosted in this read-only Google Drive folder:







Inside you'll find:



 The full brief (READ FIRST/)

 3 scenes of script + voice-over + storyboard images (References/, Storyboards/, Voice Over/)

 A preview MP4 showing scene-change timing

 Channel style references and mascot turntable

The storyboard is creative guidance, not strict frame-by-frame instructions. Creative improvements are welcome if they fit the channel style.



The test evaluates:



 Pacing

 Comedic timing

 Visual clarity

 Ability to follow instructions

 Communication

 Workflow organization

 Overall YouTube retention quality



Technical requirements: 



 Resolution: 1920 × 1080

 Frame rate: 30 fps

 Export format: MP4 (H.264)



Required deliverables:



 Final MP4 export

 Project files

 Assets used during production



Time & deadline: 



 Approximately 4–6 hours of work expected

 Hard deadline: 48–72 hours from receiving the test

 Smooth animation is not the priority — strong storytelling, efficient workflow, and engaging pacing matter more



How to submit:



When finished, upload your deliverables (MP4, project files, assets) to your own Google Drive folder set to view-only, then submit the link via our submission form:







The form takes ~1 minute to fill out. Do not
 files directly — the form is the only submission channel.



Step 3 — Final Selection :

The later stages of recruitment become much more selective. The final decision is based on:

 Reliability

 Communication

 Speed

 Consistency

 Ability to work long-term within the BattlePaws production pipeline



If you're officially selected after the test phase, you receive a $75 USD bonus alongside your first project's compensation.

Payment structure



 Month 1: paid per video at the starting rate

 Month 2+: increased per-video pay for strong performance

 Long-term top performers: transition into a stable full-time position with performance bonuses tied to video success



Ready to apply?



Send your application via this job post. Follow the 6-item checklist in Step 1 above — that's the only thing we check at the first pass.



We respond to all serious applications, even if it's a 'no' — silence isn't our style.



Looking forward to seeing your work.

— The BattlePaws Team

title: Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist - Work From Home
description:
Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist - Work From Home



Important: Please Read This Full Position Brief Before Applying



We will only consider applicants who read and follow the full instructions in this job description.



If you do not follow the application requirements exactly, your application will not be considered and may be marked as spam.



About the Role

We are hiring a work-from-home Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist.



This is not cold calling. You will be contacting warm leads who have responded to our advertising, usually during the same day or the previous day. These leads have already shown interest and understand that they have made an inquiry.



Your main role is to call as many leads as possible throughout the day, speak with potential clients, and qualify whether they may be eligible for a Total and Permanent Disability insurance claim to be developed by our legal team.



Calls are made through a dial pad inside our CRM. Each tea
mber is provided with their own access so calls can be tracked and monitored.



The Person We Are Looking For

We need someone who is a self-starter, confident on the phone, organised, and able to approach the role with enthusiasm and tenacity.



Success in this role is measured by:



Calls made

Leads qualified

Client sign-ups

Accurate follow-up work

Strong organisation and communication

Exceptional, fluent spoken English is essential. If you are not able to confidently and fluently converse in English, please do not apply.



Additional Admin Responsibilities

Once a client is qualified, there are administrative steps that must be completed. This includes gathering information from the client, sending initial inquiries to insurers and superannuation funds, and staying on top of follow-up tasks.



You will work closely with our Philippines-based admin team and our Sydney-based legal team. You will help make sure matters continue moving through the process, including following up on medical certificates, employment records, insurer information, superannuation fund responses, and other required documents.



There may be times when all leads have been contacted before the end of the day. When that happens, you will be expected to move into admin-related work. Flexibility is very important in this role.



Hours and Working Arrangement

This is a contracted work-from-home role.



Hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Sydney time.



As a contractor, you are responsible for your own equipment, internet connection, local obligations, and working setup in the Philippines.



We are a stable and mature company with strong long-term prospects for remote work. The role includes two weeks of vacation time over Christmas, pro-rated depending on your start date, as well as agreed holiday time.



Tools and Training Provided

We will provide access to:



CRM

Legal CRM

DocuSign

Dialpad

Training to get you up to speed

Strict Application Requirements

To apply, you must
 your application to:







Your
 subject line must be:



Application - Outbound Dialer - [Your Full Name]



Your application must include:



An up-to-date CV

A short covering letter

An original 60-second voice recording reading the script below

The recording must be made specifically for this job application. Do not send an old recording, a generic voice sample, or an AI-generated recording.



Script for Voice Recording

“Hi, my name is [your name], and I’m calling in relation to your recent inquiry about a possible Total and Permanent Disability insurance claim.



I just need to ask you a few quick questions to understand your situation and see whether this may be something our team can assist with.



The call should only take a few minutes. I’ll go through some basic details with you, and if it looks like you may qualify, our team can explain the next steps and what information may be needed.



Is now still a good time to speak?”



Final Note

Applications that do not follow the instructions above will not be considered and may be marked as spam.

title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description:
About Us



We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.)



This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone).



Our Stack (you'll work across most of this)



-Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps)

-Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API)

-Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation)

-ActiveCampaign (automations, API)

-Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run)

-REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job

-LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API)

-WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code.

-Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API)

-Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments

-Softr (client portal on top of Airtable)

-Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs



You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation.



What You'll Do



-Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems)

-Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability

-Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google

-Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings

-Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for.

-Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms

-Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break)

-Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions.

-Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this



Compensation



-Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience

-Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance.

-Annual base increases for strong performers

-Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months



Hours Of Work



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME.



Who This Role Suits



-5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool

-You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail

-You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround"

-You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain)

-You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked

-You test your own work before calling it done

-You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first

-You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs



Who This Role Does NOT Suit



-Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps

-Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role

-Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs

-Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours)

-Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination.

-Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point.



Security Note (read this — it matters)



We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Required:



-Zapier (Expert)

-Airtable (Expert)

-AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert)

-API Integration / REST APIs (Expert)

-WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced)

-Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced)

-Python (Advanced)

-HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced)

-Webhooks (Advanced)

-Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced)



Strongly preferred:



-Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce)

-ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)

-Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions)

-Flask or similar Python web frameworks

-Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking



Nice to have:



-Softr / no-code app builders

-Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs

-SQL





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read:



1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post.



2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't.



3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.)



4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem?



5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively.



7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning.



If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

title: Recruiting Manager Manage High Volume US Recruiting Team
description:
Position: Recruiter Manager-Manage a High Volume Recruiting Team for USA Projects



You must be a highly experienced Recruiting Manager experienced in hiring, training and managing a team of expert US experienced recruiters specialized with reviewing a high volume of resumes daily spanning 7 days per week 14 hours per day. Average volume of resumes that are currently being reviewed ranges from 400 to 600 per day which will increase to 750 to 1250 per day.



In addition to resume reviewing are our Job Ad Team who create post and manage from 1,000 to 1,200 job ads currently which will increase to 1,750 to 2,500 job ads within 6 months and much higher volume within 1 year.



Your schedule will need to be flexible during EST hours Monday to Friday and some hours may be required to monitor or in some instances fill in for a recruiter that is not available to provide service on a weekend day.



Responsibilities:

• Review and Quality Control all resumes being reviewed daily and also get actively involved with ad creation, development and management for approval and make necessary corrections and train team

• Monitor Daily KPI's for resumes being reviewed and Job ads being created and posted

• Consistently maintain a high level of motivation and culture on a daily basis for the team

• Collaborate with management team to ensure alignment between job requirements and daily priorities

• Conduct research for better software, technology, services and methods of improving and streamlining operations.

• Hire, train and add on addition team recruiters to continue growing the department on an as needed basis

• Create various reports on a daily basis for review with Management



If you feel you are qualified for this management role, please apply for this position, we look forward to hearing from you if you are, thank you!





Here is more detailed info for the ad creator poster and the resumes reviewers that we use to explain the positions so you will have a better idea if this role is for you!



NOTE: Please keep in mind that you must be highly experienced with US Recruiting including hiring training and managing High Volume US recruiting experts.



Here is some details for the roles you would be managing:



PHONE SCREENERS-We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and proactive Resume Screener to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing and evaluating
incoming resumes everyday for a variety of job positions. Your primary task will be to qualify or disqualify candidates based on their prior experience, answers to questions, location, and skill sets that align with employers' needs. This position requires someone with strong attention to detail, a keen eye for spotting key qualifications, and the ability to work efficiently in a very high-volume, fast-paced environment.



IMPORTANT: Please let us know how many years of experience you have reviewing US candidate resumes and if you have the experience to review 300 to 500 resumes per day accurately......Please list these details in your response...Thank you!



Responsibilities:

• Review and assess incoming resumes to ensure alignment with job requirements.

• Evaluate candidates based on their experience, answers to questions, location, and relevant skills

• Consistently maintain a high level of accuracy in identifying qualified applicants.

• Collaborate with hiring teams to ensure alignment between job requirements and candidate profiles.

• Manage a high volume of resumes while ensuring quality and consistency in evaluations.



Requirements:

**CANDIDATE NEEDS TO BE 100% FLUENT IN SPEAKING, READING AND WRITING ENGLISH**

• Strong attention to detail and ability to spot key qualifications quickly.

• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of resumes.

• Ability to work efficiently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Previous experience in resume screening or recruitment in the US is a MUST

• Able to work 6 days per week during EST/eastern standard time hours

• Proficiency in Job Websites such as ZipRecruiter, Indeed, etc.



JOB AD CREATOR -Job Ad Creator (MUST be an Expert navigating and posting ads on Indeed)-We are seeking an expert recruiting professional not to recruit but to focus 100% on Developing effective job ad copy to maximize quality and quantity of applying candidates. You must really be an expert at creating compelling job ads and have a vast amount of experience working with and positing on the job boards and social media. You will be creating new fresh and compelling job ads daily and manage over 2,000 live job ads posted on all the major job boards including social media platforms. You will be responsible for creating and developing engaging job ad campaigns and content on major job boards and social media.



We are seeking a highly detail-oriented creative writing professional to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for writing compelling self- created ads for various job board websites. Your primary task will be to self- create new fresh compelling ad copy daily (Not looking for an AI Copy Cat) You will need to always be analyzing the market and geographical areas ads are being posted in so you can create ads that will attract high quality and high quantity of candidates for all types of positions. This position requires someone with strong attention to detail, a keen sense of how to create effective ad copy that will attract a high volume of quality candidates, and the ability to work efficiently in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.



Employment Ad Copy writing experience along with expert level knowledge of how to maneuver and effectively post on the Indeed and other major job boards along with social media is a must.



Work Scope:

• Self-Create job ads and post daily on Indeed

• Write compelling, original ad copy and job titles that attract quality candidates(Not looking for a Chat GPT Copy and Paster)

• Regularly update and optimize existing ads to maximize visibility

• Maintain and manage our ad tracking system/database to ensure performance

• Monitor ad performance and flag underperforming campaigns for revision



Qualifications:

• Experience with creating and posting jobs on Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, etc.

• Experience writing catchy, clear, and professional ad copy

• Have strong attention to detail and are organized with data

• Understand how to identify and attract the right type of candidates

• Thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

• Tech-savvy and familiar with spreadsheets or job ad management tools



Important:

• Prior experience in recruiting focused on ad creation and posting a high volume of ads daily in the US Market is a MUST!

• Understanding of SEO or keyword optimization for job postings is a MUST!
