As the Accounting Operations Lead, you will report to the Chief Financial Officer and be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations across our three short-term rental brands.



You will lead a small team of external and internal bookkeeping and accounting resources. Initially, much of the work will involve managing external bookkeeping and accounting partners, ensuring their work is completed accurately and on time, and taking day-to-day accounting coordination off the CFO’s plate. Over time, this role may help build, train, and lead internal accounting tea
mbers as we bring more accounting processes in-house.



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple accounting workstreams at once. You should be able to create structure, identify gaps, follow up on open items, and ensure accounting processes are completed accurately and on time.



WORKING HOURS

This is a full-time role aligned to U.S. Central Time. Required schedule: 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time, Monday-Friday.



Central Daylight Time to Philippines Time:

* 9:00am-5:00pm CDT = 10:00pm-6:00am PHT

* Because the Philippines does not observe daylight saving time, the Philippines time equivalent may shift when the U.S. changes between CDT and CST.

* Candidates must be comfortable working overnight Philippines hours on a consistent basis.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

This is a full-time independent contractor role based in the Philippines.

* Base pay: $1,700-$2,300 USD per month, based on experience.

* Compensation at the higher end of the range will be reserved for candidates with direct U.S. short-term rental accounting experience, Guesty experience, homeowner statement and payout experience, CPA certification, and prior leadership of bookkeeping or accounting resources.

* 13th month pay: Offered in December and prorated for partial years.

* PTO: Accrues at 1 paid day per month, usable after 90 days, with no annual rollover.

* Long-term opportunity: This is intended to be a long-term role with the opportunity to grow into a broader accounting leadership position as we continue building our internal finance and accounting team.



YOU WILL OWN

* Day-to-day accounting operations across Sierra Sol, Third Coast, and Redwood Coast.

* Month-end close coordination across all operating brands.

* Chart of accounts maintenance and accounting structure improvements.

* Homeowner statement review and homeowner payout support.

* Vendor payment workflows and accounts payable coordination.

* Tax filing and remittance support.

* End-to-end accounting flows across property management systems, accounting platforms, banking/payment tools, and reporting processes.

* Coordination and accountability of external and internal bookkeeping resources.

* Accounting SOPs, checklists, calendars, and process documentation.



ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES



ACCOUNTING OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT

* Manage day-to-day accounting workflows across Sierra Sol, Third Coast, and Redwood Coast.

* Coordinate accounting activities across multiple markets, brands, entities, and accounting resources.

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for external and internal bookkeeping resources.

* Ensure accounting tasks are completed accurately, consistently, and on schedule.

* Maintain clear accounting task lists, close calendars, open-item trackers, and follow-up routines.

* Identify process gaps, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve accounting workflows.

* Create structure and accountability across the full accounting process.



MONTH-END CLOSE

* Own and coordinate the month-end close process across all operating brands.

* Maintain the monthly close calendar and ensure deadlines are met.

* Review reconciliations, open items, supporting schedules, and accounting workpapers.

* Coordinate with bookkeeping and accounting resources to resolve missing information or discrepancies.

* Prepare summaries of close status, unresolved issues, and items requiring CFO review.

* Support timely preparation of market-level and company-level financial reporting.

* Help ensure each market’s financials are accurate, consistent, and ready for leadership review.



CHART OF ACCOUNTS AND FINANCIAL STRUCTURE

* Help maintain and improve the chart of accounts across multiple entities and operating brands.

* Ensure transactions are coded consistently across markets.

* Support department, market, homeowner, property, and entity-level reporting needs.

* Help create scalable accounting structures that support business growth.

* Document accounting policies, workflows, coding rules, and reporting standards.

* Identify where account structure, classes, departments, properties, or other reporting dimensions need to be improved.



HOMEOWNER STATEMENTS AND PAYOUTS

* Support the preparation, review, and accuracy of homeowner statements.

* Help ensure homeowner payouts are processed accurately and on time.

* Review homeowner charges, owner proceeds, adjustments, deductions, reimbursements, and management fees.

* Investigate and resolve homeowner accounting questions or discrepancies.

* Ensure property-level revenue, expenses, fees, and reimbursements are properly reflected.

* Help maintain clean and accurate homeowner accounting records.



VENDOR PAYMENTS AND PAYABLES

* Manage and improve the vendor payment process.

* Ensure vendor bills are properly received, coded, approved, and scheduled for payment.

* Coordinate with market teams to resolve missing invoices, approvals, W-9s, or supporting details.

* Support payment tracking, vendor statement review, and payables reporting.

* Help ensure strong controls around vendor payments and expense approvals.

* Identify recurring vendor payment issues and recommend process improvements.



TAX FILING AND REMITTANCE SUPPORT

* Support lodging tax, sales tax, occupancy tax, and other required tax filing and remittance processes.

* Track filing deadlines and payment due dates by market.

* Coordinate with internal and external resources to ensure filings are prepared and submitted on time.

* Reconcile tax liability accounts and investigate discrepancies.

* Maintain supporting records for tax filings, payments, and related schedules.

* Help ensure tax processes are documented, repeatable, and scalable across markets.



END-TO-END ACCOUNTING FLOWS

* Manage accounting workflows across systems such as property management software, accounting platforms, payment tools, bank accounts, and reporting tools.

* Support the flow of reservation revenue, guest payments, owner payouts, management fees, vendor charges, taxes, reimbursements, and company revenue.

* Help reconcile data between property management systems, banking/payment platforms, and accounting software.

* Identify broken workflows, missing data, duplicate entries, reconciliation issues, and process gaps.

* Create and maintain SOPs for key accounting processes.



SYSTEMS AND TOOLS

* Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software is required.

* Experience with Guesty is strongly preferred.

* Experience with short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting systems is highly valuable.

* Experience with tools such as Topkey, Breezeway, AppFolio, Buildium, Hostaway, Streamline, Track, OwnerRez, or similar platforms is a plus.

* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills are required.



TEAM AND RESOURCE MANAGEMENT

* Lead a small team of external and internal bookkeeping and accounting resources.

* Assign tasks, follow up on progress, and hold resources accountable to deadlines.

* Review work quality and escalate issues when needed.

* Help train future accounting tea
mbers as the internal team grows.

* Build SOPs, checklists, and process documentation to support future scalability.

* Help create a high-quality internal accounting function over time.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

* 5+ years of accounting, bookkeeping, finance operations, or related experience.

* Prior experience supporting a U.S.-based short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality business.

* Experience with homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, property-level accounting, trust/escrow-style workflows, or similar accounting processes.

* Experience with U.S. accounting practices and working with U.S.-based companies.

* Strong QuickBooks Online experience or experience with similar accounting platforms.

* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.

* Experience managing month-end close tasks and reconciliations.

* Experience coordinating with bookkeepers, accountants, operators, or business leaders.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Ability to work 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time.



STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

* CPA certification.

* Guesty experience.

* Experience with short-term rental or vacation rental homeowner statements.

* Experience with homeowner payouts and homeowner accounting.

* Experience with lodging tax, occupancy tax, sales tax, or similar tax remittance processes.

* Experience with multi-entity businesses.

* Experience supporting multiple markets, locations, or operating companies.

* Experience building accounting SOPs and process documentation.

* Experience leading or supervising bookkeepers or accounting assistants.



WHAT WE LOOK FOR

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Proactive and comfortable taking ownership.

* Strong follow-up and accountability.

* Able to manage multiple deadlines and workstreams.

* Comfortable working with U.S.-based leadership teams.

* Able to identify accounting issues and recommend solutions.

* Process-minded and interested in building scalable systems.

* Clear, professional, and responsive in communication.

* Comfortable leading other accounting resources.

* Excited to grow with a company over time.



LOCATION

This role is fully remote within the Philippines. Candidates must have reliable internet, a quiet professional work environment, and the ability to work overnight Philippines hours aligned to U.S. Central Time.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit the following:

* Resume/CV.

* Brief written summary of your accounting experience.

* Details of your experience with U.S. short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting.

* Any experience you have with Guesty or similar property management systems.

* Any experience you have with homeowner statements, homeowner payouts, trust/escrow-style accounting, lodging tax, or month-end close.

* Your experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting systems.

* Your experience managing bookkeepers, accounting assistants, or external accounting resources.

* Your expected monthly compensation in USD.

* Your availability to work 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time.

* Speedtest.net result screenshot.



REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTIONS

Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. Describe your experience with U.S. short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting.



2. Have you worked with Guesty? If yes, what accounting-related tasks did you handle inside or connected to Guesty?



3. Have you prepared or reviewed homeowner or owner statements? Please explain.



4. Have you supported homeowner payouts, lodging tax, sales tax, occupancy tax, or trust/escrow-style accounting?



5. What accounting software have you used? Please describe your QuickBooks Online experience.



6. Tell us about a time you managed bookkeepers, accounting assistants, or external accounting resources.



7. Describe your month-end close experience.



8. Are you a CPA? If yes, please include details.



9. What is your expected monthly compensation in USD?



10. Can you consistently work 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time?



Applications that do not describe relevant short-term rental, vacation rental, property management, or hospitality accounting experience will not be considered.

title: SENIOR MARKETING & CHANNEL SPECIALIST | ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS
description:
SENIOR MARKETING & CHANNEL SPECIALIST



ABOUT ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS



Elevated Hospitality Partners is a growing vacation rental management platform supporting multiple local hospitality brands across Texas, New Mexico, and California. We manage high-quality vacation homes with a focus on strong homeowner partnerships, thoughtful guest experiences, local market expertise, and disciplined operational execution.



As we continue to grow, we are building a centralized marketing function that supports all of our markets, improves the performance of our listings, strengthens our homeowner acquisition efforts, and helps us present a consistent, premium brand across every channel.



ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and creative Senior Marketing & Channel Specialist to support marketing across our vacation rental portfolio.



This role will report to our Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with our market teams, revenue management, onboarding, field operations, and external marketing partners.



This is a hands-on marketing role focused on listing optimization, channel content quality, website updates, homeowner acquisition marketing, referral channel support, brand consistency, and select social media support. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, comfortable with digital tools, highly organized, and excited to help build scalable marketing processes for a growing hospitality business.



This role is especially important because our listings, websites, homeowner-facing content, and referral channels directly impact our ability to grow revenue, attract new homeowners, and create a premium brand experience across every market.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



LISTING OPTIMIZATION & CHANNEL CONTENT

* Own the quality, consistency, and optimization of property listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, Google Vacation Rentals, direct booking websites, and other distribution channels.

* Write and refine listing titles, descriptions, summaries, photo captions, amenity highlights, and market-specific content.

* Review listings for completeness, accuracy, conversion quality, and brand consistency.

* Help determine the best hero images, photo order, captions, and property highlights for each listing.

* Coordinate with market teams to confirm property details, amenities, local recommendations, and unique selling points.

* Manage the listing optimization checklist for new and existing homes.

* Support the launch of new listings by ensuring marketing content is complete, accurate, and on-brand before going live.

* Review underperforming listings and recommend content, photo, or positioning improvements.

* Manage the relationship with photography partners to help ensure property photography is high quality, consistent, and aligned with our brand standards.

* Coordinate photography needs, shot lists, photo feedback, and follow-up requests with market teams and external photographers.



WEBSITE & DIRECT BOOKING SUPPORT

* Maintain and update property pages, market pages, owner-facing pages, and other website content.

* Ensure direct booking websites are accurate, polished, and aligned with current listings and brand standards.

* Support the creation of landing pages for market-specific campaigns, homeowner acquisition, and referral partners.

* Help improve website content for SEO, readability, and conversion.

* Coordinate with website vendors or internal tea
mbers when technical changes are needed.

* Support updates to Google Business Profiles and other local search assets.



HOMEOWNER ACQUISITION MARKETING

* Support marketing efforts designed to attract new vacation rental homeowners.

* Help create and maintain homeowner-facing materials, including one-pagers, brochures, market summaries, case studies, listing improvement examples, and sales support materials.

* Support
 campaigns, nurture sequences, and other marketing efforts for prospective homeowners.

* Help package the EHP value proposition clearly across markets, including our approach to home care, revenue management, guest experience, and owner communication.

* Create market-specific content that helps homeowners understand why our local teams are the right partner for their vacation rental.



REFERRAL CHANNEL MARKETING

* Support marketing efforts for referral partners, including real estate agents, brokers, developers, designers, contractors, and other local professionals who may refer homeowners to us.

* Help create referral partner collateral, outreach materials,
 campaigns, and follow-up content.

* Maintain referral channel marketing assets and ensure they are professional, clear, and easy for partners to share.

* Support the marketing side of our lifetime value of leads strategy, helping us stay visible and valuable to referral sources over time.

* Coordinate with leadership and market teams to identify partner opportunities and create simple, repeatable campaigns.



BRAND & CONTENT CONSISTENCY

* Help maintain consistent brand voice, tone, and visual standards across all markets and channels.

* Create and manage templates for listings, owner marketing, referral partners, social media, presentations, and website content.

* Use tools like Canva and Google Workspace to produce clean, professional, on-brand marketing materials.

* Ensure each local brand feels personal and market-specific while still reflecting the quality and standards of Elevated Hospitality Partners.



REPORTING & PROCESS MANAGEMENT

* Maintain a marketing tracker for listing optimization, website updates, referral marketing, owner acquisition campaigns, and active projects.

* Provide regular updates to the Chief Commercial Officer on progress, priorities, and blockers.

* Track key marketing activity, including listings optimized, new listings launched, website pages updated, referral materials created, and campaigns supported.

* Help build repeatable marketing processes as we scale across markets.

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and quality across our marketing work.



SOCIAL MEDIA

* Support social media content across our brands, with a primary focus on homeowner brand awareness and homeowner acquisition rather than guest marketing.

* Create and maintain a simple content calendar focused on brand credibility, homeowner education, market presence, property highlights, team stories, and referral partner visibility.

* Repurpose listing content, market insights, owner-facing content, and local stories into social media posts.

* Create professional, on-brand graphics and short-form content using Canva or similar tools.

* Ensure social media supports the broader business goal of building trust with homeowners and referral partners.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Listings are polished, accurate, compelling, and consistent across channels.

* New homes are launched with complete and high-quality marketing content.

* Website and direct booking content stays current and professional.

* Homeowner acquisition materials are organized, clear, and easy for the sales team to use.

* Referral partner marketing is consistent and professional.

* Photography partners receive clear direction and deliver brand-aligned property photos.

* Marketing projects are tracked, prioritized, and completed on time.

* The company has stronger marketing systems that can scale across multiple markets.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

* Excellent written English and strong editing skills.

* Experience in digital marketing, hospitality marketing, vacation rental marketing, real estate marketing, or a similar field.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage many listings, projects, and deadlines.

* Experience writing marketing copy for websites, listings,
s, or social media.

* Comfort working with digital platforms, website builders, channel tools, spreadsheets, and project trackers.

* Strong Canva or basic graphic design skills.

* Good understanding of brand consistency and premium presentation.

* Ability to work independently, ask smart questions, and organize work clearly.

* A proactive, problem-solving mindset.

* Interest in hospitality, travel, real estate, and vacation rentals.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required:

* Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or Google Vacation Rentals

* Guesty or another property management system

* Vacation rental or short-term rental marketing

* Real estate or property management marketing

* Website CMS tools

* Google Business Profile

* Google Analytics

* Meta Business Suite

*
 marketing tools

* SEO basics

* Photography coordination or creative direction



TOOLS YOU MAY USE

* Guesty

* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* Google Vacation Rentals

* Google Workspace

* Canva

* Meta Business Suite

* Google Business Profile

* Website builder tools

* Project management or tracking tools

* AI writing and productivity tools



COMPENSATION

* Full-time remote role based in the Philippines

* Compensation: $1,200-$1,500 USD per month, depending on experience

* 13th month pay

* Full-time schedule

* 90-day performance and compensation review

* Long-term growth opportunity as our marketing function expands



WORKING HOURS

• This is a full-time role aligned to U.S. Central Time.

• Required schedule: 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time, Monday-Friday.

• 9:00am-5:00pm CDT = 10:00pm-6:00am PHT.

• Because the Philippines does not observe daylight saving time, the Philippines time equivalent may shift when the U.S. changes between CDT and CST.

• Candidates must be comfortable working overnight Philippines hours on a consistent basis.





APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To apply, please submit the following:



1. RESUME OR WORK HISTORY

Please share your resume, LinkedIn profile, or a short summary of your relevant work experience.



2. MARKETING PORTFOLIO OR EXAMPLES

Please include examples of marketing work you have created or managed. This could include:



* Vacation rental listings

* Airbnb, Vrbo, or 
 listing copy

* Website pages

* Real estate or hospitality marketing materials

* Social media content

*
 campaigns

* Brochures, one-pagers, or Canva designs

* Before-and-after examples of listings or marketing content you improved



We are especially interested in examples related to short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, real estate, travel, or local service businesses.



3. VACATION RENTAL / OTA EXPERIENCE



Please briefly answer the following:

* Have you worked with Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, Google Vacation Rentals, Guesty, or other vacation rental platforms?

* Have you optimized vacation rental listings before? If yes, what changes did you make?

* What do you look for when trying to improve the performance of a vacation rental listing?

* What process or checklist do you use to make sure a listing is complete, accurate, and attractive to guests?

* How do you think about the differences between Airbnb, Vrbo, direct booking websites, and other OTAs?



4. LISTING OPTIMIZATION CASE STUDY

Please review the following Airbnb listing: 



After reviewing the listing, please provide a concise recommendation for how you would improve it.



Your response should include:

* A brief summary of your overall impression of the listing.

* An optimized listing title. Please provide one title you believe would perform well on Airbnb and briefly explain why.

* A rewritten and optimized version of the listing. Please rewrite the full listing copy, including the main description, property/space details, location information, guest access, and any important notes you believe should be included. The listing should be written to clearly present the property, highlight its most compelling features, and drive conversion to booking.

* Your top 5 recommended improvements. These can relate to copy, photo order, amenities, guest expectations, OTA performance, direct booking potential, or anything else you believe would improve the listing.

* Your approach to listing optimization. Briefly explain the process you would normally use when reviewing and improving a vacation rental listing.



Please keep your response practical and concise. We are looking for clear writing, strong judgment, and an understanding of how to improve vacation rental listing performance.



WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to join a growing hospitality business at an early stage and help build the marketing engine for a multi-market vacation rental platform. You will have the chance to make a direct impact on listing performance, homeowner acquisition, referral partner marketing, and brand growth across several unique vacation rental markets.



We are looking for someone who is thoughtful, organized, creative, and excited to help build something that can scale.

title: Guest Experience Specialist, Third Coast Elevated Stays
description:
Third Coast Elevated Stays is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving the Texas coast markets of Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island. We are focused on providing elevated stays for our guests and elevated stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that celebrates what makes the Texas coast special - its people, coastal culture, beach communities, and local character - while delivering elevated experiences for guests and thoughtful, reliable stewardship for homeowners.



Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS + guest inbox), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), RingCentral (calls/SMS).



Our Elevated Promises

Everything we do is guided by our Elevated Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



1. Elevated Guest Engagement: Proactive, elevated hospitality from booking to five-star review. 

We believe vacations are special—something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns great trips into truly elevated experiences.



2. Elevated Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own.

As homeowners in these markets, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Weekly home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation ready, for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



3. Elevated Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment.

Every homeowner has different goals – maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.



Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.?



Job Description: Guest Experience Specialist - Texas Coast

As a Guest Experience Specialist, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Third Coast, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. You will manage guest messaging and calls, coordinate workorders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring elevated hospitality and experiences to every stay.



You will own:

• Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

• Guest messaging and phone communication

• Workorder coordination and task follow-through

• Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

We provide live coverage from 7:00am to 11:00pm Central Time (CDT). You will be assigned a consistent shift. On-call after-hour coverage (11:00pm-7:00am CDT) is handled by a separate rotation.



Central Daylight Time (CDT) ? Philippines Time (PHT):

• 7am–3pm CDT ? 8pm–4am PHT

• 11am–7pm CDT ? 12am–8am PHT

• 3pm–11pm CDT ? 4am–12pm PHT

• 11pm–7am CDT ? 12pm–8pm PHT



Compensation and Incentives

• Base pay: $800 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

• 13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)

• Monthly 5-Star Bonus: $50 if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 60%+.

title: Dialler / Client Intake Specialist
description:
Dialler / Client Intake Specialist - Warm Leads Only



Important: Read This Before Applying

There are strict instructions on how to apply for this position. If you do not follow the instructions exactly, your application will be marked as spam and you will not be contacted.



All applications must be completed through OnlineJobs.ph.



Your OnlineJobs.ph application must include all of the following:

Your latest resume.



A covering letter explaining why you believe you are perfect for this role.

An original Loom video answering the application question at the bottom of this post.

Do not copy a script. Do not use a template. Do not read a generic answer. We want to hear how you naturally communicate in English, as if you were speaking to a real client. If your answer looks copied, scripted, AI-generated, or the same as other applicants, you will not be considered.



About The Role

TPD Matters is looking for a reliable, confident, and well-spoken Dialler / Client Intake Specialist to join our remote team.

This is not a cold-calling role. You will be contacting warm leads who have already indicated that they may need our services. Your job is to follow up with them, understand their situation, gather the right information, and help move suitable people through the early stages of our process.

We help people with Total and Permanent Disability claims, so the conversations can sometimes be sensitive. We need someone who can be professional, patient, clear, and human on the phone.

What You Will Be Doing

Calling new and existing warm leads assigned to you in our CRM.

Speaking with potential clients about their circumstances, injury or illness, work history, superannuation, insurance, and possible suitability for our services.

Taking accurate and detailed notes after every call.

Following company scripts, SOPs, training material, and intake processes.

Arranging, sending, and following up client intake documents where required.

Updating lead stages, call outcomes, tasks, reminders, and next steps in the CRM.

Following up leads consistently and professionally.

Reporting on daily activity, outcomes, blockers, and conversion issues.

Assisting with admin tasks when dialling work is complete or when directed.

Following up with insurers, superannuation funds, and related parties to help move client folders into an active stage within the business.



Performance Expectations

This is a performance-focused dialling role. Your KPIs will be based mainly on outbound dialling activity, follow-up consistency, CRM accuracy, and your ability to help move suitable leads forward.

You must be comfortable working with a CRM every day. We rely heavily on accurate notes, clean file management, task tracking, and clear communication between tea
mbers.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

Has excellent spoken and written English.

Is confident making outbound calls.

Is comfortable speaking with Australian clients.

Can sound natural, warm, and professional on the phone.

Is organised and reliable.

Can follow instructions carefully.

Is comfortable working with CRM systems, folders, files, and client records.

Takes detailed notes without needing to be reminded.

Can manage follow-ups without losing track of important tasks.

Has strong attention to detail.

Understands that sensitive client information must be handled carefully and professionally.

Experience in sales, appointment setting, claims support, insurance, legal intake, medical admin, customer service, or Australian campaigns will be highly regarded.



Why This Is A Great Opportunity

TPD Matters is a growing Australian business with a strong purpose. Our work helps people who are often going through difficult periods in their lives, and the right person in this role can make a real difference.

You will be joining a team that values clear communication, accountability, training, and long-term working relationships. This is not just a random calling job. You will learn our process, become part of the client journey, and play an important role in helping the business operate smoothly.

For the right person, this can become a stable long-term position with meaningful work, consistent expectations, and room to grow as the business grows.



How To Apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only.

Your OnlineJobs.ph application must include:

Your latest resume.

A covering letter explaining why you believe you are perfect for this job.

A Loom video link answering the application question below in your own words.

If you skip any of the required items, your application will be marked as spam and you will not be contacted.

Application Question

Record a short Loom video answering this question:

Imagine you are calling a warm lead in Australia. They have enquired about help with a possible TPD claim, but they are unsure whether they want to continue and they are a little nervous about speaking with someone.

What would you say to them?



Please answer naturally, in your own words, as if you are speaking to a real client. Do not read from a script, do not copy anything from the internet, and do not use a template. We are using this Loom video to assess your English, your tone, and your ability to communicate clearly with someone who may be stressed or uncertain.

Remember: if your answer is not original, you will not be considered.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Pex Life Records LLC: Our Vision for Transformative Music



Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

title: 3D Printing File Prep Specialist, Slicer Slicing Expert
description:
What You'll Do



You'll be responsible for preparing production-ready 3D print files at high volume for our team.



Daily work (80%):

• Open STL/3MF files from our product queue

• Set up proper print settings in Bambu Studio (orientation, supports, infill, walls)

• Export production-ready 3MF files

• Mark items complete in our system

• Target: 50-75 files per day



File hunting (20%):

• Find matching STL files on Thingiverse, Printables, Makerworld, Thangs, and MyMiniFactory when a product needs an exact file match

• Search by keyword, image, or product type

• Verify files are open-source licensed and printable

• Flag items that need custom design vs. existing files



Requirements



Must have:

• Experience with FDM 3D printing (personal or professional)

• Proficiency in Bambu Studio (required)

• Understanding of print orientation and why it matters (layer lines, strength, aesthetics)

• Understanding of support material — when it's needed, how to minimize it

• Knowledge of common materials (PLA, ABS, PETG, TPU)

• Reliable internet + computer that can run Bambu Studio

• Available full-time (40 hrs/week)



Nice to have:

• Own 3D printer for test prints on complex items

• Experience browsing and downloading from Thingiverse, Printables, Makerworld, and Thangs

• Familiarity with wall thickness, infill patterns, and bridging

• Experience with multi-piece assemblies or hardware inserts



What We Offer:

• Steady, consistent work with a high-performance team

• Clear daily targets and a straightforward workflow

• Growth opportunity as we scale



How to Apply:

Send a 2-minute video explaining why you're the perfect candidate for this position.

title: Full Time Video Editor for Full Length Podcasts and Vertical Reels
description:
We are hiring immediately for a full time video editor with specific experience editing multi-angle, 2 person, in-studio podcasts.



This role includes two main types of editing:



Long form editing: full length podcast episodes for YouTube

Short form editing: vertical reels pulled from the full podcast episodes for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
 Reels



This experience is mandatory.



Please do not apply if your main experience is anime edits, gaming videos, faceless reels, virtual podcasts, AI podcasts, stock footage videos, or general social media clips. We need someone who can show real examples of 2 person podcast or interview edits using multiple camera angles.



About The Role



We produce podcast content for clients, businesses, speakers, organizations, and creators. Most of our work includes 2 people speaking on camera in a studio or interview setup with multiple camera angles.



We need an editor who already understands how to edit full length podcast episodes, switch camera angles naturally, clean audio, color correct footage, and pull strong vertical reels from the full conversation.



This is a full time role and we are looking to hire now.



Mandatory Experience



You must have experience editing:



Full length 2 person podcasts or interviews

Multi-camera or multi-angle podcast footage

Long form podcast episodes for YouTube

Vertical reels from podcast episodes

Talking-head conversation content where pacing, reactions, and camera switching matter



Your portfolio must include this type of work.



If you do not have samples of multi-angle 2 person podcast or interview edits, please do not apply.



Responsibilities



Edit full length podcast episodes with clean pacing, natural cuts, and professional camera switching.



Edit viral vertical reels from full podcast episodes for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
 Reels.



Identify strong 
nts from the full episode and turn them into engaging short form vertical clips.



Switch between speaker close ups, wide shots, and reaction shots in a way that feels natural.



Clean and balance audio so both voices are clear, even, and easy to listen to.



Color correct, sharpen and color grade footage so the final video looks polished and consistent.



Add captions, lower thirds, titles, music, sound effects, zooms, and graphics when needed.



Export full length episodes for YouTube and vertical clips for social media platforms.



Follow detailed editing instructions and meet deadlines consistently.



Required Skills



Strong experience editing multi-angle 2 person podcast or interview content.



Strong understanding of conversation pacing and natural camera switching.



Ability to edit full length podcast episodes.



Ability to create vertical reels from full podcast episodes.



Ability to clean audio and balance voice levels.



Ability to color correct and color grade footage.



Ability to create clean, readable, accurate captions for vertical reels.



Ability to follow a repeatable editing workflow.



Strong communication and reliability.



Preferred Software



DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut Desktop, Descript, Adobe Audition, iZotope, or similar tools.



The software is less important than your ability to edit clean, professional, multi-angle podcast content.



This Role Is Not For



Anime editors.



Gaming editors.



Faceless reel editors.



Virtual podcast editors only.



Editors who mainly use stock footage.



Editors who only make motivational reels.



Editors who cannot show real multi-camera podcast or interview samples.



Editors who need to learn multi-angle podcast editing from scratch.



This Role Is For



Someone who has already edited full length 2 person podcast or interview episodes.



Someone who knows how to create vertical reels from podcast conversations.



Someone who understands conversation pacing.



Someone who knows when to cut to each speaker, wide shots, close ups, and reaction shots.



Someone who can make full length podcast episodes feel polished and easy to watch.



Someone who can find strong short form 
nts inside a full episode.



Someone who can improve audio and color without needing constant direction.



Someone who is available full time and can start immediately.



How To Apply



Please send the following:



At least 2 examples of full length 2 person podcast or interview episodes you have edited.

At least 2 examples of vertical reels you created from podcast or interview content.

At least 1 example of a podcast trailer you've created

A brief explanation of your multi-camera podcast editing process.

The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, highly dependable, and capable of maintaining absolute discretion while managing the day-to-day life of company leadership.

Requirements

- Organizational Excellence: Exceptional time-management skills with the ability to prioritize personal/family requests alongside business deadlines.

- Communication & Discretion: Flawless written and verbal communication skills; high level of discretion, trustworthiness, and professionalism when handling personal family data and executive communications.

- Tech Stack Proficiency: Familiarity with scheduling tools, communication platforms (Slack, WhatsApp), and Google Workspace.

- Adaptability: Ability to work independently, take initiative, and problem-solve with minimal supervision.





Preferred Skills

- Experience coordinating household vendors or managing family/personal calendars.

- Experience with digital marketing, social media scheduling tools, or content curation.

- Training and playbooks will be provided for our specific business tools and systems.

title: Operations Transformation Lead/Operations Builder
description:

Full-Time | U.S. EST Hours | Remote (Philippines Only)

________________________________________

About Us

We are a U.S.-based due diligence and research company serving attorneys, lenders, title companies, financial institutions, and corporate clients nationwide since 2002.

We help clients obtain critical business, legal, corporate, and public records information used in lending, legal, compliance, real estate, and corporate transactions throughout the United States.

We are currently rebuilding significant portions of our operational infrastructure, processes, systems, and team structure.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of an established company that is entering its next phase of growth and transformation.

________________________________________

This Is Not a Traditional Operations Role

We are not looking for someone to maintain an operation that is already fully built.

We are looking for someone who can help build it.

This role is for a builder, problem solver, and operational leader who enjoys creating structure, accountability, visibility, and scalable systems where they do not yet exist.

You should enjoy:

•	Building processes from the ground up

•	Creating order from complexity

•	Solving operational challenges

•	Leading change and improvement initiatives

•	Driving accountability and execution

•	Helping organizations scale

If you prefer highly structured environments where everything is already documented and defined, this role is probably not the right fit.

________________________________________

Your Mission

Work directly with ownership to help transform a founder-led service company into a scalable, system-driven organization capable of delivering operational excellence, accountability, consistency, and sustainable growth.

Over time, this role is expected to become a key leadership position within the organization, helping shape team structure, performance standards, reporting frameworks, operational governance, and the systems that support future growth.

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to create operational structure, accountability, visibility, scalability, and measurable business improvement.

________________________________________

What You'll Do

•	Analyze and document how work currently moves through the organization

•	Design and implement scalable operational workflows

•	Build accountability, reporting, and performance management systems

•	Establish KPIs, scorecards, and operational visibility

•	Create structure where processes are currently informal or inconsistent

•	Develop SOPs, operational standards, and governance frameworks

•	Identify bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities for improvement

•	Support team development, performance, and accountability

•	Partner with leadership on strategic initiatives and operational priorities

•	Help build the operational foundation required for future growth and scalability

title: Customer Support Representative (Bilingual: English & Spanish)
description:
Deos is a fast-growing Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) personal care brand. We are looking for an experienced, high-level Customer Support Representative to join our team for the long haul.



This is a fast-paced role for someone who is genuinely outgoing, loves interacting with people, and takes pride in delivering an exceptional client experience. We do not do robotic, copy-paste interactions—we want independent problem-solvers who bring warmth, empathy, and emotional intelligence to every single chat,
, and ticket.



The Details



Role Type: Contractor / Freelance

Hours: 30–40 hours per week (Full-time availability preferred)

Pay: $5–$10 USD per hour (Depending on experience and skill level)

Trial: 1-month paid trial period to ensure a perfect fit



Key Responsibilities



Ticket & Order Management: Managing customer inquiries via
 and chat, efficiently handling order status requests, shipping delays, and product questions.



Order Operations: Utilizing backend platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop to process refunds, exchanges, and subscription modifications.



De-escalation: Turning frustrated or anxious customers into loyal, happy fans by handling complex, emotionally charged situations seamlessly.



Core Requirements (Must Haves)



• Experience: Proven, solid experience in Customer Support is strictly required. This is not an entry-level position.

• E-commerce/DTC Expertise: You must have previous experience working with a DTC brand. You should already thoroughly understand how e-commerce shipping, tracking, and returns work without needing to be taught.

• Language Requirements: Fluent English (written and spoken) is a must. Full fluency in Spanish is also required, as you will actively handle communications in both languages.

• Independence: Highly proactive and self-motivated. You do not need to be micromanaged; high-level communication, deep empathy, and customer satisfaction should be second nature to you.

• Workspace: A quiet workspace with a reliable, fast internet connection.



Tools We Use / You Must Know



Shopify, TikTok Shop, Loop (Order lookups, editing orders, subscriptions)

Commslayer (or similar helpdesk software)

Slack & Google Suite



P.S. We value authenticity and fast, independent thinking. Please note that our interview process includes a live, on-the-spot customer scenario test during the video call. You will be asked to resolve a real-world customer issue in real-time, without relying on ChatGPT, AI, or pre-made scripts. If you are ready to show us your genuine support skills, we look forward to your application!
